title: Protection warrior: fires Shield Wall then Last Stand as its health falls

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts Shield Wall at least once while its own health is at or below 50 percent
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:79-81 (low health -> shield wall at ACTION_MEDIUM_HEAL, staggered early at 20-50 percent); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:344-346 (lowHealth 50, criticalHealth 20); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: three mobs on the tank should drive it through the 20-50 percent band, but Shield Wall has a 30 min cooldown so only the first fall counts. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: The Protection warrior casts Last Stand at least once while its own health is at or below 20 percent
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:83-85 (critical health -> last stand at ACTION_EMERGENCY + 2, only below 20 percent); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:344 (criticalHealth 20); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the priest heals the tank, so the bot may never reach the critical band in 180 s; Last Stand at EMERGENCY+2 only fires when it does. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: the Protection warrior holds Defensive Stance (aura 71) for at least 85 percent of its in-combat samples, so the defensives fire on a tank in stance
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:63-65 (defensive stance row, ACTION_HIGH + 2); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorTriggers.h:20 (DefensiveStanceTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the standalone stance row returns the bot to Defensive Stance on the next tick; only the overpower dance leaves it briefly. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
